body:
I have exported some data from BigQuery in AVRO format using DEFLATE compression. 
I can use fastavro to read through the AVRO file and output the dataframe, however when trying to use with `cudf.read_avro` I get the following error:

`RuntimeError: cuDF failure at: /conda/conda-bld/libcudf_1571332739543/work/cpp/src/io/avro/avro_reader_impl.cu:79: Cannot parse metadata`

Example code:

```
import pandas as pd
import cudf
import dask_cudf as dc
import dask.dataframe as dd
from fastavro import writer,reader, parse_schema

#works
with open('/data/lv.avro000000000000', 'rb') as fo:
    records = [r for r in reader(fo)]
df = pd.DataFrame.from_records(records)
df.head(2)

None | None | None | NaN | None | {'make': None, 'model': None, 'ua': None, 'ver... | 5.1 | c4626a4d-37a4-47a2-9ea8-cfe211166bab | idfa |   | ... | [{'k': 'conn', 'v': 'EDGE'}] | 100001 | [] | gps | None | None |   | 2019-09-08 21:05:27+00:00 | {'id': None, 'id_type': None} | None



#doesnt work
df = cudf.read_avro('/data/lv.avro000000000000', engine='cudf')

RuntimeError: cuDF failure at: /conda/conda-bld/libcudf_1571332739543/work/cpp/src/io/avro/avro_reader_impl.cu:79: Cannot parse metadata
```

I am pretty new to working with cuDF so it is entirely possible I am missing something
